description: Réseau CVLmobilité - information temps réel ligne A (format GTFS-RT) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté de Communes Chinon Vienne et Loire. CC Chinon Vienne et Loire, AOM local, organizes a regular public transport line connecting Saint-Benoît-la-Forêt, Chinon, Beaumont-en-Véron, Avoine, Port-Boulet and Bourgueil. The data shows the following real-time information: tripupdates; vehiclepositions. Coverage: Communauté de Communes Chinon Vienne et Loire. The portal shows the English title as "Network CVLmobility - real-time information line A (GTFS-RT format)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté de Communes Chinon Vienne et Loire. Its keywords include bus, gtfs-rt. The listing shows 2024-09-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
